Challenge

Grab the ship — a thrust-rosette blooms. Drag a handle out and release: that Δv is spent at the ship's point and the orbit re-draws from the new state. Prograde grows the far side; retrograde shrinks it (over-do it → reentry); radial turns the apse line. Push toward the warm ring and cross it to escape. The Δv tube drains by Tsiolkovsky.

On the rail. Drag the throttle up the rail and release to light the booster.
